scope.en: Inspect main-paper data on physical PDF pages 1–9 (all pages if shorter). Full appendix and later pages are auxiliary reference.
scope.zh: 检查 PDF 前至多9个物理页面内正文数据；完整附录及后续页面仅作辅助参考。

quick_rules.en: Inspect the first 9 physical pages (all pages if shorter) for collected-data defects. Do not grade the original author's prose style, logic, novelty or scientific correctness.
quick_rules.zh: 检查前至多9个物理页面内的数据缺陷，不评价原作者文风、逻辑、创新或科学正确性。

quick_rules.en: Give four core ratings. Only non-text assets allow N/A when no relevant objects exist; use Uncertain when evidence is insufficient, not when a defect is confirmed.
quick_rules.zh: 完成四项核心评分。只有非文本资源在范围内无相关对象时可选 N/A；证据不足选无法判断，已确认缺陷按程度评分。

quick_rules.en: PDF visual quality is a separate optional fifth check. Overall is a direct usability judgment, not an average or automatically capped total.
quick_rules.zh: PDF 视觉质量为独立选填第五项；总体可用性直接判断，不求平均或自动限分。

quick_rules.en: Full PDFs and appendices remain available as auxiliary reference. Normal conference-version revisions and the planned page-nine boundary are not data defects.
quick_rules.zh: 完整 PDF 和附录可辅助查阅；正常会议版本修订及预设第9页边界不算数据缺陷。

title.zh: 数据可用性审查 · 前至多9页

text.en: Score collected main-paper data, not native writing quality or exact conference-version alignment. Appendix, references and later pages are auxiliary. Resource inventories cover their declared scope only.
text.zh: 评收集到的正文数据，不评原生写作或与会议版本精确对齐；附录、参考文献及后续页面仅辅助参考，资源清单只覆盖其声明范围。

text.en: Scan the assigned window for text loss/corruption, broken structure and unusable technical objects. Check suspicious passages or resource evidence as needed; a full scientific peer review is not required. Confirm only the scope you inspected.
text.zh: 浏览窗口内文字丢失或乱码、结构损坏与技术对象不可用等问题，按需细查疑点与资源证据；不要求完整科学同行评审，只确认实际检查范围。

text.en: A source resource inventory supports file-level checks; it does not prove page-specific completeness, actual pixel legibility or correct association. Unused files may appear. Generated tables, math and TikZ need no separate images. Missing evidence means unknown, not absent.
text.zh: 源码资源清单支持文件级检查，不证明逐页完整性、像素可读或关联正确；可能包含未使用文件。表格、数学与 TikZ 无需独立图片；证据缺失表示未知，不表示资源缺失。

text.en: Count physical PDF pages from 1, not proceedings numbers. Exclude reference and appendix sections even inside the window. Do not penalize a later conclusion, continuation after page 9 or reasonable appendix deferral. Full appendix reading is not required.
text.zh: 从 PDF 首页计物理页，不按论文集页码。窗口内参考文献和附录仍不计核心分；后续结论、第9页之后续写与合理附录分配不扣分，无需读完整附录。

text.en: Rate confirmed data damage by its repair burden. A rendering-only problem belongs in the visual check; use intact same-source content for core ratings where available. If evidence prevents judgment, choose Uncertain. Do not invent source checks or treat native awkward writing as collection damage.
text.zh: 根据已确认数据损坏的修复负担评分。纯渲染问题放视觉检查，有完整同源内容时据此评核心分；受证据限制则选无法判断。不虚构源码检查，也不把原生不流畅写作当收集损坏。

text.en: After core completion, you may reveal the official PDF for a separate version audit. Submission/camera-ready changes and publisher headers/footers do not lower data-usability scores by themselves.
text.zh: 核心完成后可显示官方 PDF 单独观察版本。投稿与定稿修订以及出版页眉页脚本身不降低数据可用性分。

text.en: Earlier writing/alignment ratings remain archived. This protocol starts blank and requires four answers plus inspection confirmation. Visual checks, version observations and notes are optional.
text.zh: 旧写作与对齐评分保留归档；本协议从空白开始，四项回答加检查确认即可完成。视觉检查、版本观察与备注均选填。
